sourced_tooltip: This input is covered upstream: the sourcing configuration of this plan draws it from another plan's snapshot instead of buying it at market.
sourced_oversubscribed_tooltip: This input is covered upstream, but the source is oversubscribed: all plans drawing from it together take more than its daily output, so this plan's share is not actually available.
subscribed_tooltip: Units per day other plans draw from this output through their sourcing configuration, as a share of this plan's daily output. Above 100% the output is oversubscribed.
our_cost_tooltip: Daily cost of this input at the sourcing configuration ({price} ȼ/u) instead of the CX preference price shown above. From the stored sourcing snapshot.
